versions.content: Th e range of the PN request information in the NM user data is defined by the parameters FrNmPnInfoOffset and FrNmPnInfoLength . Each bit in the PN range shall have the following meaning: Bit value Meaning: Specification of FlexRay Network Management AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 48 of 119 Document ID 28 : AUTOSAR_SWS_FlexRayNetworkManagement - AUTOSAR confidential - 0 - > The PN is not requested 1 - > The PN is requeste d Note : FrNmPnInfoOffset + FrNmPnInfoLength shall not exceed the Length of the NM PDU.
